sources.scheduleAndPlayByPlay: ESPN historical scoreboard and game summary endpoint
sources.openingRole: PBP Stats get-shots/nba, first-quarter shot attempts during the first 120 seconds; only game possession 1 or 2; all history filtered to before the evaluated game
sources.actualStarters: ESPN final boxscore. Starter truth is known after games; archived pregame announcement timestamps were not available.
sources.syntheticArchive: fb-model/data/fb_database.sqlite was excluded because its ingestion script generates randomized play-by-play and seeds fixed example lineups.

modeling.comparison: same date-ordered 10,000-trial possession simulation and prior-only player/defense/tip inputs; v7 adds the production L5/L10 opening-role blend to v6 season-role shares
modeling.l5L10Blend: 35% L5 + 65% L10 recent share; recent blend weight rises from 5% at five games to 10% at ten games
modeling.otherInputs: player shot-zone mix and makes from prior ESPN play-by-play only, shrunk to league priors; tip rates from prior historical opening jump balls only; neutral early-turnover/OREB priors
caveats: Lineup-conditioned retrospective test, not a complete pregame availability replay.
The range evaluates the opening-role adjustment, not a perfect reproduction of every v6/v7 production feature or live roster prior.
Metrics on player probability proper scores are reported only when the actual first scorer is among the ten actual starters.
